title: MycoScout habitat or distant visual observation
description: An inspection lead, never a species ID or freespace observation. Unknown capture time is allowed for screen-only historic photos. Runtime gates in habitat-search.mjs additionally enforce synchronized timestamps, uncertainty, freshness and geometry.

cueType.description: Color contrast alone always routes to unconfirmed habitat follow-up; never species or confirmed mushroom presence.

measuredRange.description: Physical camera-to-target range with explicit provenance, synchronized to the original image. Range alone creates no navigation position. Synthetic pixel-distance planning assumptions are forbidden here.

capturedMs.description: Original capture timestamp in the shared monotonic clock. Null when unknown. Never substitute model completion time.

confidence.description: Input model/reviewer confidence; not calibrated probability of mushroom presence.

signals.description: Strengths in [0,1]. Generic scene labels cannot populate hardwood, moss or damp_ground without separate supporting evidence.

semanticFractions.description: Optional image fractions for display/context only; never occupancy or traversability.

bbox.description: Image-space proposal only. Coordinates alone never provide metric range.

capturePose.description: Simulation pose contract. Actual projection additionally requires calibrated full 6-DoF camera transforms and covariance. Matching calibrationId on metric and capturePose is necessary for non-synthetic range routing.
